question: One item was missing from my order. How much refund do I get?
expected_answer: A full refund of the missing item's price, including the tax charged on that item.
must_contain: full refund of the price of the missing item

question: I paid by UPI. How long will my refund take?
expected_answer: 2 to 3 working days (working days = Monday to Saturday, excluding public holidays).

question: I paid by credit card. How long will the refund take, and is there a faster option?
expected_answer: 5 to 7 working days to the card. Faster option: choose QuickKart Wallet credit, which arrives within 5 minutes, but the choice cannot be reversed.
must_contain: Credit or debit card: 5 to 7 working days|cannot be reversed once it is made

question: I used a promo code on my order. If one item is refunded, do I get its original listed price back?
expected_answer: No. You get the amount you actually paid for that item after the discount.
must_contain: refunded at the amount you actually paid

question: Can I return a sealed packet of biscuits just because I changed my mind? Does it cost anything?
expected_answer: Yes, if it is sealed, unused and in original packaging, within 7 days of delivery. A return pickup fee of Rs. 30 is deducted from the refund.
must_contain: within 7 days of delivery|return pickup fee of Rs. 30

question: My order arrived 25 minutes after the estimated time. Do I get anything?
expected_answer: Yes, Rs. 30 in QuickKart Wallet credit. Delays up to 15 minutes get nothing; 25 minutes falls in the 15 to 30 minute band.
must_contain: up to 15 minutes after the estimate|more than 15 minutes and up to 30 minutes

question: My order arrived 45 minutes after the estimated time. What compensation do I get?
expected_answer: Rs. 75 in QuickKart Wallet credit (delay between 30 and 60 minutes), added automatically within 30 minutes after delivery.
must_contain: more than 30 minutes and up to 60 minutes

question: My order is more than 60 minutes late. What are my options?
expected_answer: Either cancel for a full refund including delivery and handling fees, or keep the order and receive Rs. 75 in wallet credit once it is delivered.

question: It was pouring rain and my order was 40 minutes late. Will I get late-delivery credit?
expected_answer: Not if the app showed the Weather Delay Mode banner at checkout, because then no late compensation is paid. Without that banner, a 40 minute delay would earn Rs. 75.

question: I cancelled my order 10 minutes after placing it, before the delivery partner picked it up. What will I pay?
expected_answer: A cancellation fee of Rs. 20, deducted from the refund. Free cancellation only applies within the first 2 minutes.
must_contain: A cancellation fee of Rs. 20 is deducted

question: I scheduled a delivery and want to cancel 30 minutes before the slot starts. What will it cost?
expected_answer: Rs. 40 cancellation fee, deducted from the refund. This is different from the Rs. 20 fee for normal orders, because it is inside the last 60 minutes before the slot.

question: How long do I have to report a problem with fresh milk compared with packaged noodles?
expected_answer: Fresh milk (dairy, perishable): within 24 hours of delivery. Packaged noodles (non-perishable): within 48 hours.
must_contain: Perishable items: report within 24 hours|Non-perishable items: report within 48 hours

question: I received a yogurt that was already past its expiry date. What do I get and what do I need to do?
expected_answer: A full refund plus a Rs. 50 wallet credit. Yogurt is dairy (perishable), so report within 24 hours, with a photo clearly showing the expiry date on the label.
must_contain: full refund plus a Rs. 50|expiry date on the label

question: Do the wallet credits I get for late delivery expire?
expected_answer: Yes, compensation credits expire 90 days after they are added. Money you add yourself and credit from refunds never expires.
must_contain: expire 90 days after they are added|never expires

question: Can I pay cash on delivery for a Rs. 2,500 order? Is there any extra fee for COD?
expected_answer: No, COD is only available up to Rs. 2,000. COD orders carry a Rs. 10 handling fee.
must_contain: up to Rs. 2,000|COD handling fee of Rs. 10

question: How much will I pay in delivery-related fees on a Rs. 250 order?
expected_answer: A delivery fee of Rs. 25 (free only from Rs. 299) plus a handling fee of Rs. 5, so Rs. 30. A surge fee of up to Rs. 30 may also apply in heavy rain or between 7 PM and 10 PM.
must_contain: delivery fee of Rs. 25|handling fee of Rs. 5

question: My order came 35 minutes late and one item was missing. What can I claim?
expected_answer: Both resolutions apply separately: Rs. 75 late-delivery wallet credit (30 to 60 minute band) and a full refund of the missing item.

question: Can I change my delivery address after I have placed an order?
expected_answer: Not covered in the documents. The assistant should say it does not know and suggest contacting support.

question: Does QuickKart sell alcohol or cigarettes?
expected_answer: Not covered in the documents. The assistant should say it does not know.

question: Is there a paid membership that gives unlimited free delivery?
expected_answer: Not covered in the documents. Only the free delivery threshold of Rs. 299 is mentioned, and no membership. The assistant should say it does not know.
